messages:
Mina: FYI — Amberlin dedicated cluster had another isolation event this morning. symptoms: intermittent VPC peering flap + services falling back to limited capacity. posting a quick follow-up thread to lock owners and timelines for the onprem constraints and playbook update.
Raj: Thanks. quick root cause blurb from initial triage: MTU mismatch on the customer's edge + an onprem NAT translation bug causing TCP stalls during rekey. looks like recurring pattern across 3 incidents in 30 days.
Sarah: Copy. I'm tracking customer comms — Amberlin engineering team requested a concrete remediation plan and timeline before EOD Friday.
Mina: Action items I propose (short):
- AI-amber-01: network fix (MTU + NAT) owner=Raj, target=2w (JIRA-8472)
- AI-amber-02: playbook update & runbook owner=Sarah, target=1w (add preflight checks)
- AI-amber-03: monitoring rule owner=Raj, target=3d (alert on >3 peering flaps/24h)
- AI-amber-04: logs export + compliance package owner=Oliver, target=4d
Please ack and add if missing.
Oliver: Ack. I'll also coordinate SLA credit calc with finance, flagging for the account exec.
Raj: I can own AI-amber-01 and AI-amber-03. technical plan:
- short term: add BGP session refresh + temporary MTU clamp on gateway (hotfix)
- medium term: deploy NAT translation fix in staging, run soak test + perf
Snippet for hotfix:```ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1492 && systemctl restart bgpd```
Will open PR and link to JIRA.
Sarah: I'll take AI-amber-02. plan to add checklist items to the dedicated/playbooks repo: preflight MTU test, BFD health probe, connection drain policy, steps to validate after peering bounce. Also add an incident pattern section describing recurring peering flaps and suggested mitigations.
incident-bot: New postmortem draft created: https://docs.internal/redwood/pm/amberlin-vpc-peering-draft
Mina: Two cross-check asks: 1) can we capture a short verification playbook so CS can run it with Amberlin ops? 2) are there automated regression tests we can add to Dedicated CI to detect this pattern?
Raj: I'll draft the verification steps (smoke cluster commands + logs to collect). need a test cluster for NAT scenario — @ops can you provision a small repro?
Oliver: I'll pull the export logs and share S3 link, compliance will need the timeline and packet captures.
Sarah: I'll include a one-page runbook snippet the CS team can run, and a playbook PR by Wed.
Mina: Great. weekly check-ins until closed — calendar invite for Thu 10am. please update the JIRA tickets when PRs or test results land. thanks all. :thumbsup:
